quality.conclusion: Quality not approved. There is a major DDG performance improvement elsewhere, but current Qwen performance is essentially unchanged and this bounded review finds 21 candidate full-class variants absent from nine baseline observations (three current plus six same-distribution historical). Seven are local pure rethrow wrappers and one preserves a typed null. Two have concrete new-to-observed-baselines invalid Java forms (TitleBarMenuConfigManager constructor and AMapUtils Thread.run); UCDataFlow restores a body containing invalid syntax; AbstractDao changes cleanup scope; eight other classes change checked exception signatures and one changes callee alias. Historical presence and omitted-count decreases do not establish correctness, stable frequency, or optimization causality. Existing finally/DEX reconstruction concerns remain unresolved.
